assertions.evidence: The agent fetched the live catalog via models.ts and GET: ran '/tmp/.../models.ts classification/request.json --json > classification/catalog.json' and also requested https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models?output_modalities=decisions; catalog.json lists current models.

They compared candidates by running decide.ts with --compare across the same probes and saved results in classification/probe-results.json showing model_id entries for upstage/solar-decide, jaredpalmer/kev-4b, and typesafe/jev-1.13 for each case.
classification/config.json pins a versioned canonical slug in a single value: "model": "typesafe/jev-1.13-20260917" (not a ~latest alias).
The stored results include the response model string with answers, e.g., pinned-results.json entries have "model": "typesafe/jev-1.13-20260917" alongside the returned answers.

They probed thresholds by running real API calls over representative inputs before fixing any cutoff: classification/probe-results.json and pinned-results.json contain probabilities per label, while config.json keeps "min_selected_probability": null.
